name: Temporary post-MVP initiative projection refresh

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - planning/post-mvp-initiative-catalog

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: planning/post-mvp-initiative-catalog
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Allow repository projection workflow to settle
        run: sleep 15

      - name: Reconcile latest branch state
        run: |
          git fetch origin planning/post-mvp-initiative-catalog
          git reset --hard origin/planning/post-mvp-initiative-catalog

      - name: Remove one-shot workflow from final tree
        run: git rm .github/workflows/tmp-post-mvp-initiative-refresh.yml

      - name: Refresh deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Verify refreshed projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          python3 -m py_compile scripts/sync-github-project-metadata.py

      - name: Commit, reconcile, and push
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: refresh generated post-MVP projections"
          fi

          git fetch origin planning/post-mvp-initiative-catalog
          git rebase origin/planning/post-mvp-initiative-catalog

          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          git add -A
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            if git log -1 --format=%an | grep -Fqx 'github-actions[bot]'; then
              git commit --amend --no-edit
            else
              git commit -m "chore: refresh generated post-MVP projections"
            fi
          fi

          git push origin HEAD:planning/post-mvp-initiative-catalog
